title: A separated morphism of schemes is quasi-separated
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] which is separated [def-weil-proper-morphism], i.e. whose diagonal $\Delta_f:X\to X\times_YX$ is a closed immersion. Then $f$ is quasi-separated [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism], i.e. $\Delta_f$ is quasi-compact.
